description.en:
The region ID of the scenario.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~131035~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
资源场景ID。

您可以通过调用[ListTemplateScratches - 查询资源场景列表](~~610832~~)接口查看资源场景ID。

descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，删除杭州地域的资源场景`ts-4f83704400994409****`。
descriptions.en: In this topic, a scenario whose ID is `ts-4f83704400994409****` is deleted in the China (Hangzhou) region.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ros delete-template-scratch --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --template-scratch-id ts-4f837044009944090000 --region cn-hangzhou
